skill.name: daily-routine-note
skill.description: Create today's routine note with the standard template when missing. Does not carry tasks.

skill:
create routine,prepare routine,routine note,daily routine
- Use `Today` and `Last routine note` paths from the routine hint. Do not search the vault for calendar yesterday. - Headings = existing `## …` lines from the last routine note only. If there are none, or Last routine note is `Not created`, start with `## Tasks` and invent nothing else.
- Do not call `read_skill` for `daily-routine-note-move-tasks`. - Do not carry forward, copy, or extract task lines. - Do not write `- [ ]` or `- [x]` lines. - Do not invent headings, sections, or tasks (including `## Summary`, gym, appointment-bot). - Do not call `create_new` when today's note already exists.
### Create today's routine note 1. Call `read_file` on today's path. 2. If the note exists, stop. 3. If the note is missing, call `write_file` with `create_new` using headings only from ``. 4. Stop. Do not read other skills or search for another date.
